summary: cs-core-api-phoenix exfiltrates installer host identity to hardcoded endpoint on require
details: On require(), index.js reads os.userInfo().username and os.hostname() and POSTs them as JSON (with the package name) via https.request to the hardcoded host nathanaccacio.com at path /collect. The module exports an empty object and provides no advertised functionality, so the only effect of installing or importing the package is to beacon installer host identifiers to an author-controlled, non-first-party domain. The package name resembles an internal/private scope, consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon. Request errors are silently swallowed to avoid alerting the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
